temporaryProfileMeasurement.note: Read-only metadata measurement of existing Playwright temporary profiles; ownership is not assumed. No files were removed and no profile-measurement browser was launched.

scope: Eight local fixture views with installed React, CircuitTool, axe and Chromium; no browser downloads requested.
thresholdReason: Root authorized one bounded run with a 200 MiB reserve after measuring the prior eight PNGs/result and existing temporary profile sizes. The original 1 GiB preflight failure remains preserved.
